snapshot_semantics: Rows reflect manifests captured at this cutoff, not a live dashboard. Finished is a collection state; save status, native termination and routing are separate.

usage_policy: Observed usage is a lower bound when usage_complete=false. Ordinary calls count native completed model replies; unknown retries and missing usage stay separate. Missing fields are null, not zero. Auto allocations omit prompts, rationale and private IDs.
